[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent [[Ted Kennedy]] was re-elected to an eighth term in office over Jack Robinson III and [[Carla Howell]]. For only the second (and final) time in his career, Kennedy polled more than 70 percent of the vote. The election was notable for a strong third-party performance from Howell on the [[Libertarian Party (United States)|Libertarian Party]] ticket, less than one percentage point behind Robinson, the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] nominee. This divided opposition resulted in Kennedy's largest-ever margin of victory, although he had recorded a higher percentage of the popular vote [[1964 United States Senate election in Massachusetts|in 1964]]. He also won every municipality in the state for the only time in his career. ==General election== ===Candidates=== * Dale E.
